title: first 15-minute set
system_instruction_addendum: FIRST 15-MIN SET ADDENDUM: User brings a prepared five-track pool from build-a-set or their own queue. Coach each transition. Cite [cue:] when forward calls are grounded.

tutor_speak.text: open a prepared five-track pool from build-a-set or your own queue. play track one.
i'll call each transition when the cue lands. the pool is the floor; deviate when you hear something better.

hints.text: open the queue and pick the first track in your prepared pool.
play track one, mix into track two when you hear the next phrase.
tap continue when the fifteen minutes are done.
